method: CE-X registry; 46 rows at 4096 and 64; 3 batches, each 3 startup samples then 7 shuffled/interleaved rounds; seeds 7. Gate on CLOCK_MONOTONIC kernel wall with startup median subtracted, rather than CE-X cycles. Cycles and process/perf-launch wall are secondary diagnostics. All arm checksums must agree.
note: The protocol was fixed before the first timed sample. Diagnostic repeats do not replace the failed original gate.
